correctness.rationale: Reconstructed symmetric edge-mixing energy decrement exactly 2mu(1-mu)(x_u-x_v)² with conserved average; the generator and graph Laplacian spectral gap yield E[H(t)]<=H(0)exp(-2alpha mu(1-mu)lambda2 t). Independent first local refresh T~Exp(n) gives E[H(T)]<=nH/(n+2alpha mu(1-mu)lambda2). If H(T)<Delta², every coordinate is strictly on same side of Allee threshold, making the corresponding region invariant and eventual correct absorption; Markov gives the bound. For n=2, x=(1,0), mu=1/5, theta=9/20, first edge then refresh initially empty site has probability alpha/(alpha+2)², reaches (.8,0) with mean .4<.45, and the bound from that new initial state shows extinction probability->1 as alpha grows; lower and upper bounds give Theta(alpha^-1). The full universal bound is analytic, not inferred from finite examples. Rechecked rational edge decrement and sharpness route independently.
